dispute.description: I was at the pickup point at Tiong Bahru Plaza on time but the driver never showed up. I waited 10 minutes at the lobby and couldn't find the car. The app charged me a $5.00 cancellation fee for a 'no-show' which is completely unfair — I was there, the driver was not. I want the charge reversed immediately.

Please let me know, otherwise I'll have to cancel the trip.

policy_clauses.text: Check that the pickup point, destination, ride option and passenger details in the booking are accurate. For a private hire car, book through the app and use the stated pickup and drop-off point rather than a taxi stand. Tell the driver about a material change through the app where possible.

Use the in-app trip status and messages to coordinate at pickup. If a trip is cancelled or a no-show fee appears, keep the trip and payment details and ask the platform to review the specific charge. This draft sets no fixed waiting period or fee.

Review the fare and payment information shown for the booking and the receipt after the trip. Raise an unexpected, duplicate or missing charge through the platform with the trip reference and available receipt details.
Use trip communications and report tools for ride-related matters. Share only information needed to describe the issue, and distinguish what you observed from what you are unsure about.

Follow the in-app pickup details, use available trip communication to coordinate, and record the trip status accurately. Do not represent an arrival, cancellation or no-show as verified solely from a report claim.

Use the booking and platform payment flow for trip charges, and ensure the fare is shown to the commuter upfront in the app. Do not add an undisclosed off-platform trip charge; retain relevant trip and receipt records for review.
Use passenger information only as needed to provide and support the booked trip. Keep reports factual, distinguish direct observations from assumptions, and use the platform’s support channel.
Keep booking, trip status and support information accurate. Do not use another person’s platform account or misstate trip activity.
